## How it works

<h3>Try it</h3><p>Open Topics (speech bubble) on the left toolbar, select an imported topic to inspect its details, comments and saved viewpoints. Choose a viewpoint to restore its model view. Some topics contain only text or document references. Select a component, then click 1 element selected at the top left to open Properties.</p><h3>Included samples</h3><p>This example loads Architectural.ifc and MEP.ifc with their buildingSMART BCF 3.0 sample collection: 19 archives covering issue details and model viewpoints. Each archive is imported unchanged. File names include its category and sample name.</p><h3>Developer integration</h3><p>Pass each source model and original BCF archive to <code>viewer.add()</code>. The SDK owns topic navigation and viewpoint restoration. Archives are imported unchanged; unpacked copies of their markup files are not separate archives. If a download or import fails, Retry failed files opens only the unsuccessful files.</p><p>Copy this folder and serve it over HTTP, for example <code>python -m http.server 8080</code>. The published SDK and sample downloads require internet access.</p>
